sample.description: MTurk via CloudResearch/TurkPrime; 364 female; M age 38.9, range 19-78 (after exclusions); module of a combined Qualtrics survey (2018)

pages.page: intro block (BL_8erBiw1ev17Y2Pz): QID2 study heading and instructions

condition block page 1: QID6 instruction, scenario (QID3/20/38/51), four comprehension checks (who decided, % died, advantage, success; options shuffled; custom validation: only the correct choice accepted; error message missing (Qualtrics library message MS_5gRgOyl9up8STd3))
condition block page 2: QID17/27/43/56 instruction + reminder, scenario (QID12/28/44/57), decision evaluation 3 to -3 (QID11/29/45/58, vertical), explanation text (QID63-66)
condition block page 3: reminder + scenario (QID82-85), responsibility 1-7 (QID72/73/75/76), norms 1-5 (QID77/78/79/81)
funneling block (BL_1N59yiFAoQqUCEd), one page: QID86 purpose (text), QID88 seen before (No / Yes + text box), QID87 improvement comment (text)

combined survey's shared funneling and demographic questions (Ziano et al. 2023 supp. pp. 25-26): seriousness 1-5, age, gender, country of birth, family social class, English understanding 1-7; position after the modules and paging derived
combined-survey wrapper: consent, the other module(s) in random order, the payment funnel question (funnel_pay)

intro.text: This study has one scenario, and 2 parts. There are 9 questions in total.
The first part contains 4 questions, to ensure that you understood the hypothetical scenario presented. The second part contains 5 questions asking for your evaluations of the scenario.
Please read the scenario and items carefully.
There are no right or wrong answers, answer to the best of your understanding and according to your own preferences.

phs.text: Please read the descriptions carefully and answer the questions that follow.

phs.text: A 55-year-old man had a heart condition. He had to stop working because of chest pain. He enjoyed his work and did not want to stop. His pain also interfered with other things, such as travel and recreation. A type of bypass operation would relieve his pain and increase his life expectancy from age 65 to age 70. However, 8% of the people who have this operation die from the operation itself.
His physician decided to go ahead with the operation.
The operation succeeded.
